title: An analyzer reads ScannerContext.isExcludeTests()
description: The exampleOrg analyzer prints '[example analyzer] ScannerContext.isExcludeTests() = <value>' when it analyzes probe.bal, and reports rule 1 once per document. With the tests excluded, the rule 1 issue in tests/main_test.bal is dropped. On scan tools without the method, the line says 'not available'. Needs plugins built after the analyzer learned the probe (npm run setup:plugins). Not available before 0.13.0.

steps.name: Tests scanned
steps.note: Prints false; 3 rule 1 issues (main.bal, probe.bal, tests/main_test.bal).
